nodes.title: Zip code areas
nodes.content:
import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import box

# Three zip code areas near the Loop, in longitude and latitude (EPSG:4326),
# with how many green roofs each holds.
areas = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    {"zip": ["60601", "60602", "60603"], "roofs": [14, 6, 9]},
    geometry=[
        box(-87.630, 41.880, -87.620, 41.890),
        box(-87.640, 41.880, -87.630, 41.890),
        box(-87.640, 41.870, -87.630, 41.880),
    ],
    crs="EPSG:4326",
)
# A second geometry column: each area's centroid, kept as points.
areas["centroid"] = areas.geometry.centroid

return areas
nodes.goal: Return three zip code areas as a GeoDataFrame in EPSG:4326: zip (object), roofs (int64), geometry (polygons, active), centroid (points, a second geometry column).
